english: The mummy of an Egyptian woman who died in 800 B.C. has just had an operation.
text: has just had an operation 把古代木乃伊当作刚做完手术的病人，形成报道里的幽默反差。have an operation 是接受手术；若说医生实施手术，可用 perform an operation，选择取决于从病人还是医生的角度讲。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
